knobs.name: adaptivestackstart
knobs.summary: gc varies initial goroutine stack size adaptively
knobs.justification: Goroutine stacks are JVM carrier stacks of fixed size (-Xss); there is no adaptive initial stack to enable or disable.

knobs.name: allowmultiplevcs
knobs.justification: Subsystem not present in the graalgo runtime (no net/http, crypto, cmd/go, etc.); the knob is accepted and ignored.

knobs.name: asyncpreemptoff
knobs.justification: No signal-based async preemption exists in graalgo; preemption is via cooperative safepoint polls. Effective behavior always equals asyncpreemptoff=1.

knobs.name: cgocheck
knobs.justification: No cgo in graalgo; there are no cgo pointers to check.

knobs.name: checkfinalizers
knobs.summary: GC runs partial STW collections to diagnose finalizer issues
knobs.justification: Requires gc's partial stop-the-world analysis of finalizer reachability; JVM Cleaner-based finalizers (P2-M4) cannot be analyzed in this mode.

knobs.name: clobberfree
knobs.summary: fills freed spans with garbage to catch use-after-free
knobs.justification: Would require allocator cooperation to poison freed spans; the JVM heap offers no such hook. Setting it would silently provide no checking.

knobs.name: containermaxprocs
knobs.summary: derive GOMAXPROCS from cgroup CPU quota (def 1)
knobs.justification: Cgroup CPU quota is never consulted; GOMAXPROCS comes from --gmp or host carriers. Effective behavior always equals containermaxprocs=0.

knobs.name: cryptocustomrand
knobs.justification: Subsystem not present in the graalgo runtime (no net/http, crypto, cmd/go, etc.); the knob is accepted and ignored.

knobs.name: dataindependenttiming
knobs.justification: No crypto/subtle package; no data-dependent timing to normalize.

knobs.name: decoratemappings
knobs.justification: No direct memory-mapping management; nothing to annotate.

knobs.name: disablethp
knobs.summary: disable transparent huge pages for the heap (Linux)
knobs.justification: Memory management is delegated to the JVM; THP policy is not controllable from the runtime.

knobs.name: dontfreezetheworld
knobs.summary: don't preempt all threads on fatal panic/throw
knobs.justification: The fatal-panic path never freezes the world; effective behavior always equals dontfreezetheworld=1.

knobs.name: efence
knobs.summary: electric-fence allocator: one object per page
knobs.justification: Would require one-object-per-page allocation; impossible on the JVM heap. Setting it would silently provide no checking.

knobs.name: embedfollowsymlinks
knobs.justification: Subsystem not present in the graalgo runtime (no net/http, crypto, cmd/go, etc.); the knob is accepted and ignored.

knobs.name: gccheckmark
knobs.summary: checkmark GC mode: verify mark bits with second STW cycle
knobs.justification: Requires running the collector in a verifying checkmark mode; the JVM GC cannot be driven this way.

knobs.name: gcpacertrace
knobs.justification: The JVM GC has no Go-style pacer; there are no pacer decisions to log.

knobs.name: gcshrinkstackoff
knobs.justification: No shrinkable Go stacks; goroutines run on JVM carrier stacks.

knobs.name: gcstoptheworld
knobs.justification: Cannot force a stop-the-world collection per cycle on the JVM GC, nor attribute STW timing in gc's terms.

knobs.name: gctrace
knobs.summary: print a line per GC cycle to stderr
knobs.justification: Emulated: a line is printed to stderr per JVM GC cycle (shape-compatible with gc's gctrace line; numbers are JVM-heap sourced, documented in GODEBUG.md).
